Definition: Meremoth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Meremoth = "elevations"; 1) a priest, son of Uriah of the family of Koz active in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem and in the 7th course of temple service in the time of Ezra and Nehemiah; 2) a priest in the time of Zerubbabel; 3) a returning exile of the family of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
